~2MB source code but ~250MB total install with bundled Chromium

Cross-browser support (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit)

Browser and API automation tools

Cloud-hosted browser infrastructure

Covers Playwright MCP, Browserbase, mcp-chrome, Browser Use, Webfuse, Chrome DevTools MCP
All solutions require 200MB+ downloads or cloud subscriptions

Side-by-side comparison of 8 browser MCP servers

stats.fact: bwb-browser source code is 76KB — the smallest MCP browser server by a factor of 25x+
Playwright MCP requires ~250MB total install with bundled Chromium
Puppeteer MCP requires ~400MB total install with bundled Chromium
bwb-browser has 25 MCP tools including browser_act, browser_watch, browser_diagnose
bwb-browser v3.1.1 was published 2026-07-28, only 3 days old at time of research
983 weekly npm downloads in first week of release
8 GitHub stars, 3 forks — very early stage project
Playwright MCP has 35,668 GitHub stars — the dominant incumbent
bwb-browser works on Termux/Android — no other MCP browser server supports mobile
bwb-browser uses raw Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) via WebSocket — no Playwright, Puppeteer, or Selenium dependencies
bwb-browser supports live console/network event capture via browser_watch — unique feature not found in Playwright MCP or Puppeteer MCP
MIT licensed, created by Krish Tiwari (@krshforever)
